newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NETBALL-Silver Fern captain scores political cap.
newsitem.headline: NETBALL-Silver Fern captain scores political cap.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Jan 30 - Silver Fern and Wellington netball captain Tanya Cox has been named as the private secretary to Minister of Sport, Fitness and Leisure, Murray McCully.

Goal keeper Cox, who led Wellington and PIC to victory in the national provincial and national club competitions last season, starts her new position in the minister's office on February 3, The New Zealand Press Association reported.
